items: Every row: no other record keeps its own level. Azarain uses the rung-01 leaf `EncVigilantOfStendarr01DarkElfF` 10C44E as his template but not for `Stats`, so changing rung 01 (on *Common Vigilants*) does not move him.

`DLC1VQ01VigilantTolanCorpse` carries `Stats` and follows Tolan; Adalvald follows `EncVigilantOfStendarr02NordM02`; Moric follows the Forsworn Briarheart template, and the records that keep their own level beside `EncForsworn02TemplateBossMelee` are on Forsworn → *Forsworn Briarheart*; Volk follows `LvlVigilantOfStendarr` (on *Common Vigilants*).
